title: Rubio's 2020 intelligence committee provision and Mick's tweet
summary: Merrick von Renenamp tells of Rubio's 2020 intelligence committee provision and Mick's tweet, about 2020 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 20th, 2020. Uh this is when Rubio snuck a uh a provision into you know what I'm talking about, right? stuck a provision into uh Senate in um intelligence committee language

plain: Speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a man named Merrick von Renenamp says that in 2020 a US senator, Marco Rubio, quietly slipped a provision into the written report of the Senate Intelligence Committee, the Senate panel that oversees the spy agencies. He brings it up while arguing with Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, and the story is also tied to something West tweeted. If it happened as described, it would mean UFO questions were being pushed into official intelligence business through the back door.
